usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-interest` command and listed it in `help` right after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes all 10 tests, and the work is committed.

That is the main open question in `.work/report.json`. Also, `show` is unchanged, so its line doesn't list interest, though its outstanding amount includes it.
